notes.title: Version 1.0.3 released.
notes.notes:
Hello,
It seems, even after several months of testing, the game is not as bug free as I initially believed... Pretty naive of me... What can one do, other than just to sit next to the keyboard and start fixing those, right?

The first fix adds some collider fixes which shouldn't allow walking "offscreen" in the forest scene (if the player did not satisfy the conditions to be allowed to venture into the woods, which should then be allowed instead). Additionally hotspots for the crypt and crypt door were separated to make them a little more accessible.

Have fun!
